title: Srinagar to Leh to Manali with Turtuk (10N/11D)
reportingPoint: Arrive at Srinagar Airport and reach the hotel or houseboat, where our representative meets you. Reporting details are shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: About 1,600 km by road between Srinagar and Manali
Srinagar to Leh via Sonmarg, Zoji La, Drass, Kargil and Lamayuru
Nubra Valley over Khardung La, with Diskit Monastery and the Hundar sand dunes
Night in camps at Pangong Tso
Leh–Manali Highway via Moore Plains, Gata Loops and Baralacha La
overview:
This **10 Nights / 11 Days** road trip crosses Ladakh from Srinagar to Manali, covering about 1,600 km with Leh, Nubra Valley, Turtuk and Pangong Tso on the way. The trip starts in Srinagar, not Delhi: you reach Srinagar Airport on your own and go to the hotel or houseboat, where our representative meets you. It ends in Delhi after the journey down from Manali. Batches run from July to September.

From Srinagar you travel through Sonmarg and over Zoji La to Kargil, then on to Leh via Lamayuru, Magnetic Hill and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib. From Leh the route goes over Khardung La to Nubra Valley for two nights, with a day trip to Turtuk, then via Shyok to camps at Pangong Tso and back to Leh over Chang La. The return is on the Leh–Manali Highway, with a night in camps at Sarchu, a day in Manali and the evening departure for Delhi. Prices start at ₹21,000 per person on triple sharing with your own bike (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.content:
Arrive at Srinagar Airport and reach the hotel or houseboat, where our representative meets you.
Check in, freshen up and relax.
You can take a shikara ride on Dal Lake or explore the Srinagar market.
Dinner, a briefing for the next day and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Kargil
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and leave for Kargil after breakfast.
Visit Sonmarg on the way.
Cross Zoji La to Drass, known as one of the coldest inhabited places in India and often called the Gateway to Ladakh.
After a lunch break, continue to Kargil.
Arrive at Kargil and check in to the hotel.
Dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kargil to Leh
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and start for Leh after breakfast.
Drive from Kargil to Lamayuru via Mulbek, Namika La and Fotu La.
From Lamayuru, Leh is about 125 km, through the Hangroo Loops and Nimmu.
On the way, stop at Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and the confluence of the rivers.
Reach Leh by evening and check in to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head towards Nubra Valley.
Ride over Khardung La and spend some time at the top.
Ride to Diskit Monastery for a view over Nubra Valley.
Stop at the Hundar sand dunes, where you can take a double-humped camel ride in the cold desert.
Dinner and an overnight stay in camps or cottages.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk and back
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive towards Turtuk.
Turtuk is the last outpost in India before Pakistan-controlled Gilgit-Baltistan, and one of the gateways to the Siachen Glacier.
The village differs in culture, language and history from the rest of Ladakh, and the landscape changes to narrow valleys and steep mountains.
Return to Nubra Valley for dinner.
Overnight stay in camps in Nubra Valley.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso via Shyok
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, leave for Pangong Tso via Shyok.
Arrive at Pangong Tso in the late afternoon. The lake is known for changing colour several times a day.
Spend the evening by the lake.
Dinner and an overnight stay in camps at Pangong.

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.content:
Wake up early for the sunrise.
After breakfast, head back to Leh over Chang La.
Reach Leh by evening and explore the local market and cafes on your last day in Leh.
Return to the hotel by evening.
Dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Leh to Sarchu
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and leave for Sarchu after breakfast.
Cross the Moore Plains, a flat, straight stretch of road about 30 km long.
After lunch at Pang, cross Lachung La and Nakee La.
Just before Sarchu, descend the Gata Loops (21 hairpin bends at 4,669 m).
Reach Sarchu and check in at the camps.
Dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sarchu to Manali
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and leave after breakfast for a long day on the road.
Drive over Baralacha La, one of the more challenging passes on the Leh–Manali Highway.
Pass Suraj Tal, a small lake at the top of Baralacha La.
Drive through Zingzing Bar, Patsio and Darcha to reach Manali.
Check in to the hotel.
Dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali self exploration and departure
itinerary.content:
After a relaxed morning and breakfast, you can head out for local sightseeing in Manali.
Places you can visit: Hidimba Devi Temple, Jogni Waterfall, Vashisht Temple and Mall Road.
Spend some time cafe hopping in the streets of Old Manali.
Leave for Delhi in the evening.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.content:
Arrive in Delhi.
The trip ends here.
